title: A six-spin obstruction to antiferromagnetic biclique maximization
summary: Sah, Sawhney, Stoner and Zhao conjectured that for every spin model whose interaction matrix has exactly one positive eigenvalue, the partition function of any graph is at most a product of biclique partition functions determined by its edge degrees. We disprove this conjecture with a strictly positive six-spin model on a triangle with three pendant edges; the violation persists on an open set of nonsingular models.
